title: Types of Vegetation in Nepal
notes: The importance of vegetation lies in its various essential roles in the biosphere: a) Vegetation plays a key role in regulating biogeochemical cycles, like water cycle, carbon cycle, and nitrogen cycle.
b) Vegetation significantly affects properties of soil like volume, chemistry, and texture.
These, in turn, affect the productivity and structure of the vegetation.
c) Vegetation serves as a habitat for wildlife and provides energy for a diverse range of animal species on Earth.
d) For humans, vegetation is crucial for food, shelter, and medicines.
e) Vegetation helps reduce erosion by intercepting rainfall, decreasing overland flow, and improving the infiltration of water into the soil.
